description: Open-source AI humanizer that rewrites AI-generated text into natural, human-sounding writing. Structure-first SFT + KTO training-data pipeline plus a runnable translation-chain humanizer (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, n8n). Transparent, auditable, MIT.
